tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The duration of engagement of the Consultant shall be currently 6 months (26 weeks). The engagement may be further extended for continued support by another 6 months (26 weeks) at the same terms and conditions
As per clause 6.3 Conditions of Contract of the tender document
All other terms and conditions as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Number of relevant assignments (eligible projects) completed with National or State Governments or its Agencies/ Organizations, SEZs for attracting investments in sectors/ functions/ industries/ capability centers in India. The nature of work should not be limited to only building marketing collateral or awareness among potential target companies and it should include direct outreach, creation of a pitch document for the target companies and attracting investments. Min. Project cost of INR 8 Cr. in India or USD 1 Mn outside India with pro-rated fees for 12 months to be considered for longer-term projects.
